While detection was generally accurate, the recovery strategies often involved slight variations of previous unsuccessful search queries or actions, leading back into similar unproductive cycles. The system terminated due to reaching the maximum number of rounds, indicating a complete failure to resolve the loops and make meaningful progress towards the answer.
